mapper.sql: select u.id, u.phone, u.name, u.sex, u.birth_year, u.zodiac, u.height, u.weight, u.hometown, u.current_city, u.education, u.occupation, u.monthly_income, u.family_members, u.has_car, u.has_house, u.house_desc, u.hobbies, u.advantages, u.smoke_habit, u.drink_habit, u.has_tattoo, u.accept_long_dist, u.photos, u.status, u.service_status, u.del_flag, u.remark, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, r.id as req_id, r.paying_id as req_paying_id, r.age_min as req_age_min, r.age_max as req_age_max, r.hometown_require as req_hometown_require, r.city_require as req_city_require, r.education as req_education, r.height_min as req_height_min, r.height_max as req_height_max, r.no_tattoo as req_no_tattoo, r.accept_long_dist as req_accept_long_dist, r.smoke_habit as req_smoke_habit, r.drink_habit as req_drink_habit, r.has_car as req_has_car, r.has_house as req_has_house, r.other_require as req_other_require, r.remark as req_remark from sys_paying_user u left join sys_paying_requirement r on r.paying_id = u.id

sql.if: and (case when u.matchmaker_id is null then u.create_by else (select s.user_name from sys_user s where s.user_id=u.matchmaker_id) end)=#{params.archiveOwner}

and u.del_flag = '0'
and u.phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and u.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and u.current_city like concat('%', #{currentCity}, '%')
and u.status = #{status}
and date_format(u.create_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
and date_format(u.create_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%Y%m%d')
order by u.id desc

if.test: education != null and education != '' and education != "0"

sql.if: and (case u.education when '1' then 1 when '2' then 2 when '3' then 3 when '4' then 4 when '5' then 5 when '6' then 6 when '7' then 7 when '8' then 8 else null end) >= (case #{education} when '1' then 1 when '2' then 2 when '3' then 3 when '4' then 4 when '5' then 5 when '6' then 6 when '7' then 7 when '8' then 8 else null end)
and (case u.smoke_habit when '0' then 0 when '1' then 1 when '2' then 2 else null end) <= (case #{smokeHabit} when '0' then 0 when '1' then 1 when '2' then 2 else null end)
and (case u.drink_habit when '0' then 0 when '1' then 1 when '2' then 2 else null end) <= (case #{drinkHabit} when '0' then 0 when '1' then 1 when '2' then 2 else null end)

if.test: cityRequire != null and cityRequire != '' and acceptLongDist == "0"

mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when del_flag = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as delFlag0Count, coalesce(sum(case when del_flag = '0' and status = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as status0Count, coalesce(sum(case when del_flag = '0' and status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as status1Count, coalesce(sum(case when del_flag = '0' and sex = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as maleCount, coalesce(sum(case when del_flag = '0' and sex = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as femaleCount, coalesce(sum(case when service_status='NOT_STARTED' then 1 else 0 end),0) as notStartedCount, coalesce(sum(case when service_status='SERVING' then 1 else 0 end),0) as servingCount, coalesce(sum(case when service_status='NOT_RENEWED' then 1 else 0 end),0) as notRenewedCount, coalesce(sum(case when service_status='SUCCESS_CLOSED' then 1 else 0 end),0) as successClosedCount, coalesce(sum(case when exists(select 1 from dating_success_case_member m join dating_success_case c on c.case_id=m.case_id where m.user_id=u.id) then 1 else 0 end),0) as successPeopleCount from sys_paying_user u where u.del_flag='0'
select count(distinct m.case_id) from dating_success_case_member m join dating_success_case c on c.case_id=m.case_id join sys_paying_user u on u.id=m.user_id where u.del_flag='0'

select birth_year as `year`, coalesce(sum(case when sex = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as maleCount, coalesce(sum(case when sex = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as femaleCount from sys_paying_user u where del_flag = '0' and birth_year is not null
group by birth_year order by birth_year
